description: Vercel CUSTOM EVENTS, the CONVERSIONS on a Vercel-hosted site (signups, purchases, any track('Name') from @vercel/analytics): the count and unique visitors over a window, and with `by` a breakdown by eventName, eventData/<property> (e.g. eventData/plan), utmSource / utmMedium / utmCampaign / utmContent / utmTerm (which ad or campaign drove the conversion), requestPath, country and the rest, or a time step. Up to TWO at once, e.g. by 'utmCampaign,eventName' or 'day,utmCampaign'. eventName narrows to one event. This is the conversion half of an ad report for a landing page on Vercel; vercel_web_analytics is the traffic half. Custom events need Web Analytics on and a Vercel Pro or Enterprise plan. Read-only, free. Needs Vercel connected (Connectors > Vercel, or connect_connector with an access token).

by.description: one or TWO comma-separated dimensions: eventName, eventData, eventData/<property>, utmSource, utmMedium, utmCampaign, utmContent, utmTerm, requestPath, referrerHostname, country, deviceType, osName, browserName, route, environment, flags, flags/<key>, or one time step hour/day/week/month/year

filter.description: Vercel's OData filter, e.g. utmSource eq 'facebook'

name: vercel_event_analytics
title: Vercel custom events (conversions)
